interview.name: Kira
interview.answer: It’s still on for Saturday, but the location hasn’t been confirmed yet.

events.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

events.text: Kira: Thanks, Bo—much appreciated. I’ll keep the list updated, so send anyone my way as you hear of them.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll send people your way as I hear of them.

events.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout already—people are bringing tools, paint, and a few snacks too. If you’re heading over, I’d go early so you can catch the organizers before it gets busy.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Kira: Oh? Is that confirmed, or just a rumor? If it’s really starting that soon, I might swing by early.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Leo: It starts at 10 a.m., and just bring the tools, tape, batteries, or spare parts you can spare.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Kira: Perfect — I’ll be there at 10 at your place with the tool kit.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Leo: Great, thanks — see you at 10.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive’s getting a decent turnout already, right? If anyone else asks, send them my way and I’ll keep the list updated.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s looking good so far—thank you, Kira. I’ll send anyone else your way and keep the list updated.

events.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. If anyone else comes up, send them my way and I’ll keep the list updated.

events.text: Kira: Right — just confirming, it’s still looking like a decent turnout already, yes?

events.text: Kira: Yes — if they can, extra tools, paint, or a few snacks would still help. I’ll keep the list updated if anyone else chimes in.

events.text: Kira: Great — just wanted to confirm it’s already looking solid. Send anyone who asks my way, and I’ll keep the list updated.

events.text: Jules: It’s still looking like the repair drive is on for Saturday, and I’m checking the final details. If you’ve got a confirmed update, I can pass it along and help round up a volunteer or two.

events.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’ve got a decent turnout already, right? If anyone else asks, send them my way and I’ll keep the list updated.

events.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’ve already got a decent turnout for the repair drive, right? If anyone else asks, send them my way and I’ll keep the list updated.
